headline: Allcargo Global announces change in directors
summary: Allcargo Global Limited has submitted a regulatory filing to the stock exchange regarding a change in its board of directors. The announcement details the departure or appointment of directors as part of corporate governance updates. Such board-level transitions are routine disclosures required under listing regulations. Retail investors holding shares should review the disclosure for any strategic shifts in company management.
why_it_matters: Routine board update with minimal immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Allcargo Global appoints Ravi Jakhar as non-executive director
hook: New board seat at Allcargo Global
summary: Allcargo Global Limited announced that its board of directors approved the appointment of Mr. Ravi Jakhar as a non-executive, non-independent director. The circular resolution was passed on October 02, 2026, with the appointment taking effect from October 01, 2026. This is a routine board level change for the listed logistics company. Retail shareholders should note the leadership addition as part of ongoing corporate governance updates.
why_it_matters: Routine board update with no immediate financial impact
